## Live product — Personalized Santa Call
- What it is: A private 3-minute AI Santa voice conversation in the browser (not a phone dial to the child).
- Who it is for: Parents/guardians preparing a Christmas surprise for one child.
- What the customer gets: Secure Stripe payment, private call link by email, 3 minutes of conversation, optional paid 5-minute extensions.
- Languages (UI + call support): Romanian and English.
- Markets / prices (fixed, no FX conversion):
  - Romania: 59 RON / 3 minutes; extension 49 RON / 5 minutes
  - United States: $12.99 / 3 minutes; extension $9.99 / 5 minutes
- Delivery time: Immediate after payment confirmation (email with private link). Start when ready; check expiry in the email.
- Adult supervision required. No child's phone number is collected.
- Landing pages:
  - https://www.thedigitalgifter.com/christmas/santa-call
  - https://www.thedigitalgifter.com/ro/christmas/santa-call
